_doc: PROGRESSION (Minecraft Dungeons style). xp needed for next level = base * growth^(level-1). Levels grant NO stats: each one only gives points_per_level Upgrade Points (spent at Software Licensing). All character power comes from gear: every item instance has a Power that scales its stats by (1 + power.stat_per_power * (power - 1)); the player's Power is the average Power of equipped gear. Drops roll around the player's Power (power.drop_spread), and enemies scale to it (power.enemy_*_per_power, reward_per_power).

corrupted._doc: Any normal enemy can spawn corrupted: chance = base_chance + per_corruption * the floor's corruption at its spawn (never in safe levels). Corrupted enemies get the multipliers below and drop Corrupted Gold (amount range, times Clearance/Power reward scaling).

rarities._doc: Data-driven rarity ladder (add a rarity here and in loot_tables.json). Spec names: common = Stock, rare = Patched, special = Overclocked, unique = Root. stat_mult scales base stats; passives = how many passive abilities an item rolls (passives.json); price_mult scales shop prices; order sorts inventories (0 = best). Root items are fused, have their own models and carry a unique effect.

tiers._doc: Basic items ("tiers": true in item files) expand into these variants; Root items are authored separately.

loot_modifiers._doc: Caps for gear bonuses that improve loot. unique_find adds to the Root chance (absolute), rare_find multiplies the chance of Patched-or-better, drop_rate multiplies the item drop chance. Caps keep Root gear rare.
